task.wait(5)
local gui = game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer.PlayerGui
local by = {}
local n = 0
for _, d in gui:GetDescendants() do
	if d:IsA('ImageLabel') and d.Image ~= '' and not d.IsLoaded then
		n += 1
		local vis = true
		local q = d
		while q and q:IsA('GuiObject') do if not q.Visible then vis = false break end q = q.Parent end
		local key = d.Image .. ' | ' .. (d.Parent and d.Parent.Name or '?') .. '.' .. d.Name .. ' | 보임=' .. tostring(vis) .. ' | rect=' .. tostring(d.ImageRectSize)
		by[key] = (by[key] or 0) + 1
	end
end
local out = {}
for k, v in by do table.insert(out, v .. 'x ' .. k) end
table.sort(out)
return '안 읽힌 그림 꼬리표 ' .. n .. '개\n' .. table.concat(out, '\n', 1, math.min(#out, 14))
